title: Shopping & Prices
description: Learn to shop in Spanish, ask about prices, compare products, and handle transactions at stores and markets.

vocabulary.source: I need to give a gift

grammar.title: ¿Cuánto? — Asking About Prices
grammar.content:
How to ask about prices:

¿Cuánto cuesta? (How much does it cost?) — singular
¿Cuánto cuestan? (How much do they cost?) — plural

Example:
¿Cuánto cuesta este libro? (How much does this book cost?)
Cuestan diez euros. (They cost ten euros.)
¿Cuánto vale esta camisa? (How much does this shirt cost?)
Valen quince euros. (They cost fifteen euros.)

Other expressions:
¿Cuánto es? (How much is it?) — total bill
¿Cuánto es todo? (How much is everything?)
Son cincuenta euros. (It's fifty euros.)
examples:
¿Cuánto cuesta este libro? (How much does this book cost?)
Cuestan diez euros. (They cost ten euros.)
¿Cuánto vale esta camisa? (How much does this shirt cost?)
Valen quince euros. (They cost fifteen euros.)
¿Cuánto es? (How much is it?)
Son cincuenta euros. (It's fifty euros.)

¿Cuánto cuesta el pan? (How much does the bread cost?)
Cuesta un euro. (It costs one euro.)
¿Cuánto cuestan las manzanas? (How much do the apples cost?)
Cuestan dos euros. (They cost two euros.)

grammar.title: Shopping Expressions
grammar.content:
Common shopping phrases:

Me gustaría comprar... (I would like to buy...)
Tengo que comprar... (I have to buy...)
Quiero... (I want...)
Necesito... (I need...)

Asking for help:
¿Me puede ayudar? (Can you help me?)
¿Dónde está...? (Where is...?)
¿Dónde están...? (Where are...?)

Paying:
¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta? (Can I pay by card?)
¿Aceptan tarjeta de crédito? (Do you accept credit cards?)
Me da el cambio? (Can you give me change?)

Returns:
Quiero devolver esto. (I want to return this.)
No me gusta. (I don't like it.)
Es muy caro. (It's too expensive.)
Es muy barato. (It's too cheap.)
¿Puedo cambiar esto? (Can I exchange this?)
examples:
Me gustaría comprar esto. (I would like to buy this.)
Tengo que comprar pan. (I have to buy bread.)
Quiero una camisa. (I want a shirt.)
Necesito agua. (I need water.)
¿Me puede ayudar? (Can you help me?)
¿Dónde está el pan? (Where is the bread?)

No me gusta. (I don't like it.)
Es muy caro. (It's too expensive.)

grammar.title: Comparando Productos
grammar.content:
How to compare products:

Este es más caro que ese. (This one is more expensive than that one.)
Ese es más barato que este. (That one is cheaper than this one.)
Este es mejor que ese. (This one is better than that one.)
Ese es peor que este. (That one is worse than this one.)

Comparando tallas:
Este es pequeño. (This one is small.)
Ese es mediano. (That one is medium.)
Ese es grande. (That one is large.)
Este es más pequeño que ese. (This one is smaller than that one.)
Ese es más grande que este. (That one is bigger than this one.)

Comparando colores:
Este es rojo. (This one is red.)
Ese es azul. (That one is blue.)
Este es más bonito que ese. (This one is prettier than that one.)
examples:
Este es más caro que ese. (This one is more expensive than that one.)
Ese es más barato que este. (That one is cheaper than this one.)

Ese es más grande que este. (That one is bigger than this one.)

exercises.question: What is store in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: Tienda = store. Panadería = bakery. Carnicería = butcher shop. Frutería = fruit shop.

exercises.question: How do you ask how much something costs?
exercises.explanation: ¿Cuánto cuesta? = How much does it cost? (singular). ¿Cuánto cuestan? = How much do they cost? (plural).

exercises.question: What does descuento mean?
exercises.explanation: Descuento = discount. Oferta = sale. Precio = price. Devolución = return.

exercises.question: Complete: ___ este libro? (How much does this book cost?)
exercises.explanation: ¿Cuánto cuesta? = How much does it cost? (singular).

exercises.question: Complete: Puedo pagar con ___. (Can I pay by card?)
exercises.explanation: Puedo pagar con tarjeta = Can I pay by card?

exercises.question: Complete: Este es ___ que ese. (This one is more expensive than that one.)
exercises.explanation: Más caro = more expensive. Este es más caro que ese = This one is more expensive than that one.

exercises.question: What is bakery in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: Panadería = bakery. Tienda = store. Carnicería = butcher shop. Frutería = fruit shop.

exercises.question: Complete: ___, ¿me puede ayudar? (Excuse me, can you help me?)
exercises.explanation: Disculpe = Excuse me. Disculpe, ¿me puede ayudar? = Excuse me, can you help me? (formal).

exercises.question: What does oferta mean?
exercises.explanation: Oferta = sale. Descuento = discount. Precio = price. Devolución = return.

exercises.explanation: Quiero devolver esto = I want to return this.
